title: Liberties, ground and open questions now read in plain words
items: Sources › Liberties: every entry is rewritten for a reader. Work numbers are gone, a building is named rather than given its record code, and a file is said as what it is, such as "the liberties register" or "the research notes on the Glessner frontage".
A cross-reference to another liberty now gives that liberty's title, so you can find it in the list. Each source an entry rests on is still named, by its title.

The ground's claims, the buildings researched and left out, and the open questions read the same way, in every year. An open question names the research note it is argued in by topic, not by file name.
Shops & work: a firm's location lines name the building by its name, and a newspaper notice by its paper and date.
